items.claim: parseBody() breaks when the formData body cache is already populated (c.req.formData() then c.req.parseBody())
items.consequence: Previously parseFormData called request.formData(), which returned the cached FormData. It now goes through HonoRequest.arrayBuffer(); when only bodyCache.formData exists, #cachedBody takes the anyCachedKey branch and rebuilds the body with new Response(formData).arrayBuffer(), which is always multipart with a fresh boundary. That body is then parsed against the original Content-Type header.
items.proposed_fix: In parseFormData, when request is a HonoRequest and bodyCache.formData is already set, await and reuse it instead of calling arrayBuffer(); otherwise keep the arrayBuffer + bufferToFormData path. Add a test for formData() followed by parseBody() for both multipart and urlencoded bodies.

native_fields.evidence: Reproduced with a bundled scratch app. multipart: c.req.formData() then c.req.parseBody() gives 500 'TypeError: Failed to parse body as FormData.' (boundary mismatch). urlencoded: the same sequence returns 200 with a garbage key '------formdata-undici-...\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name' instead of {a:'1'}, so the data is silently wrong. Order parseBody-then-formData, parseBody twice and text-then-parseBody still work. No added test covers formData() then parseBody().

native_payload.intent: Fix #5060: make Content-Type media-type matching case-insensitive in parseBody() and validator() while preserving parameters such as multipart boundaries.

actionable_findings.title: parseBody() breaks when the formData body cache is already populated (c.req.formData() then c.req.parseBody())
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: In parseFormData, when request is a HonoRequest and bodyCache.formData is already set, await and reuse it instead of calling arrayBuffer(); otherwise keep the arrayBuffer + bufferToFormData path. Add a test for formData() followed by parseBody().
actionable_findings.why_it_matters: A previously working call order (formData() then parseBody()) now returns a 500 for multipart and silently garbled data for urlencoded bodies.
actionable_findings.evidence: Reproduced with a bundled scratch app against the head source.

residual_risks: src/utils/body.ts:130 caches the formData promise before awaiting it. If multipart parsing rejects, the rejected promise stays in bodyCache.formData, and a later validator('form') awaits it at src/validator/validator.ts:115-116 outside its try/catch, giving a 500 instead of a 400 (adversarial; not run).

src/middleware/method-override/index.ts:74 and :92 still use case-sensitive startsWith('multipart/form-data') / startsWith('application/x-www-form-urlencoded'), so mixed-case media types are silently not method-overridden. This is the same bug class and was left outside the fix.

The validator regexes now use /i, which also makes parameter names such as boundary= case-insensitive (benign); parseBody (split on ';') and the validator (strict regexes) accept slightly different Content-Type strings; parseBody now buffers the whole body through arrayBuffer() (not measured).
testing_gaps: No test covers c.req.formData() followed by c.req.parseBody(); the one test that mocked req.formData() was rewritten to use a real FormData, which removed the only check tied to the old formData() call path.
No Hono-level test (c.req.parseBody through a route) for a mixed-case Content-Type; coverage is at util level.

coverage.notes: Focused path: correctness read in-context plus one independent adversarial read. The cross-model peer was unavailable under the single-model configuration, so the adversarial lens ran as a local in-process adversarial-reviewer (same model family: agreement is corroboration, not cross-model). No validator ran. No criteria files (CODING_STANDARDS.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) govern the changed files; no plan was found, so requirements were not verified. Declared Compound Packs were not applied. Learnings, agent-native gaps and deployment notes were not assessed. The runtime-tests suites and old-code side-by-side runs were not available; the regression 'worked before' comes from reading the base code. Validator /i change and the case-insensitive parseBody guard behave as intended for the cases in #5060.
